$comment: The known-failures record (docs/rig-suites.md). Each entry is ONE cause, with the date it was recorded and every suite under it BY NAME (no wildcards). rig/verdict.mjs reads it at the end of every run: a red suite not listed here is UNLISTED and named in the verdict; a listed suite that passed is reported so its entry can go. Nothing here makes a run green.

no-model-key.cause: AWS Bedrock refuses the rig's access key (UnrecognizedClientException), so every call to the model fails. Clears when the agent moves to the Anthropic API with a working key.
